detail.requirements:
• Minimum of Bachelor's Degree in analytics related field (Business Administration, Business Analytics, Statistics, Computer Science)
• Strong experience with SQL, Tableau and/or any other visualization tools
• Knowledge of Database Management concepts
• Data-Driven, analytic and proactive mindset with can do anything attitude
• Able to work independently and in a team, rigorous, detail-oriented, critical thinker and performance-driven
• Minimum 3 years of experience in Analytics
• Strong English written and verbal skills
detail.main_tasks:
• Analyze sales and delivery performance, delivering insightful recommendations to optimize operations
• Develop KPIs, tools, and dashboards to streamline business processes and boost productivity
• Build expertise in the local Korean Automotive market and other general markets impacting automotive industry to provide proactive insights to field sales leaders
• Maintain consistency, reliability, and quality across standard reports while supporting data needs for local marketing campaigns
• Create ad-hoc reports and analyses in response to requests from sales and delivery teams
• Conduct deep-dive analyses on performance metrics, presenting findings to key stakeholders
• Serve as an expert on databases, systems, and applications, offering guidance to Sales users on processes, reports, and tools
• Collaborate with managers to pinpoint improvement areas and promote effective use of analytics resources
detail.intro: Sales Analytics team is dedicated to powering a data-driven business and unlocking actionable insights from our data. We deliver critical intelligence on business performance, customer behaviors, and product trends, supporting leaders across retail locations, headquarters, and our executive team. We're seeking a talented Analyst to empower field sales leaders with tactical insights, deep local market knowledge, and proactive analytics solutions.
detail.preferred_points: • Experience with Python or other programming language is a plus
